text: Sorry it's so late. My daughter's 5 and her eczema has gone mad tonight, dry rough patches on the backs of her knees and in her elbows, and she's scratching them till they're raw. Neither of us has slept. Her breathing's absolutely fine, I checked properly, no wheeze or anything like that, it's just the itching. I've used the cream we've got and it's not touching it. Is there anything else I can do tonight or do I just wait for the GP in the morning. I'm shattered
